More intelligence." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_family:BebasNeueRegular|color:%23000000|letter_spacing:0" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|color:%23000000"]Original Stories Generated by A.I. & the Human Mind[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]The era of multi-disciplinary artists is here. The tools and technology now available to artists and designers are astounding. As Oddtoe, I adore light projection, a little bit of nature — topiary, for instance — and heavy influences from cartooning and children's book illustration. My work is comedic. The visual style is very direct, with unique, detailed characters in full backgrounds. Good typography and textured surfaces also mark my style.[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text css=""]Oddtoe's typical clients are brands, advertisers, and publishers whose user experience has been dulled by the design's "race to the bottom" (think Canva-style design) — or worse, who've failed to stand out at all. Global brands with room for a more dynamic approach to illustration and animation also tend to gravitate toward "out-there" work. Also, for some reason, individuals, couples, or foundations with money ;) seem more interested in commissioning the most distinctive work. Them them.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][dfd_button button_text="Contact Oddtoe" buttom_link_src="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oddtoe.com%2Fcontact-oddtoe%2F|title:Contact%20Oddtoe" style="style_6" background="#8a8f6a" hover_background="#4e5041" border="border-style:none;|border-radius:5px;" hover_border="border-style:none;|border-radius:5px;"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="65" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="65" screen_tablet_spacer_size="65" screen_mobile_spacer_size="65"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]

More humour. Less violence. More intelligence.

Original Stories Generated by A.I. & the Human Mind

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]The era of multi-disciplinary artists is here. The tools and technology now available to artists and designers are astounding.

As Oddtoe, I adore light projection, a little bit of nature — topiary, for instance — and heavy influences from cartooning and children’s book illustration.

My work is comedic. The visual style is very direct, with unique, detailed characters in full backgrounds. Good typography and textured surfaces also mark my style.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]Oddtoe’s typical clients are brands, advertisers, and publishers whose user experience has been dulled by the design’s “race to the bottom” (think Canva-style design) — or worse, who’ve failed to stand out at all.

Global brands with room for a more dynamic approach to illustration and animation also tend to gravitate toward “out-there” work.

Also, for some reason, individuals, couples, or foundations with money 😉 seem more interested in commissioning the most distinctive work. Them them.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]
